## About
Built and prototyped **Celestia** with a friend as a mobile app concept that combines daily affirmations with personalized astrology content. The work covered both feature planning and interface design for content discovery and monetization.

## Highlights
- **Mobile product concept:** combined affirmations, astrology content, and personalized discovery.
- **UI work:** built explore and content-discovery surfaces including a Masonry-style bottom sheet.
- **Monetization exploration:** evaluated subscriptions, token unlocks, and modular content delivery.
- **Quick stack:** **React Native**, **mobile UI**, **product design**, **interaction polish**.

## How it works
- The app is organized around personalized content discovery rather than static content browsing.
- Explore surfaces present category-driven content with visual layouts designed for higher browsing engagement.
- The product model separates free browsing from unlockable or premium content paths.
- Most of the engineering/design work focused on feature definition, UX composition, and how content systems would scale in the app.

## What I would do next
- Formalize the content model and recommendation logic.
- Test subscription versus token-based monetization with clearer user flows.
- Expand the prototype into a more complete mobile content platform.
